board: cart_a.kicad_pcb (4 layers, In1 + In2 signal layers with GND pours on all 4 layers), from cart_a_placed.kicad_pcb
note: Record of the steps after the automatic flow, in order. Pump coordinates (cartgeom_a.py). Run from cart/a with ../../board/kpy; OP_LAYERS=4 OP_IN1=1 for every router call (In1 carries signals). Freerouting is not deterministic: the committed cart_a.kicad_pcb is the source of truth, these steps document how it was closed. TEST PROJECT, water only.

steps.cmd: OP_LAYERS=4 OP_POFV=1 OP_NAME=cart_a_try12 kpy build_cart_a.py  (placement place_table.json, pins pin_assign.json) -> cart_a_try12_placed.kicad_pcb = cart_a_placed.kicad_pcb

steps.do: Freerouting, In1 as a signal layer
steps.cmd: OP_IN1_SIGNAL=1 OP_BOARD=cart_a_try12s.kicad_pcb ./flow_cart_a.sh 60  (prep_signal_a.py: no In1 plane, GND routed like any net) -> 5 signal opens after the GND pours (APHASE x2, MOT_FWD x2, PERM_L); with the In1 GND plane the same placement stopped at 7-10 opens after every finishing tool
strip_zones; OP_LAYERS=4 OP_IN1=1 kpy island_route_a.py -> PERM_L, MOT_FWD (U33) routed; APHASE x2 (U30 pad 6 walled in) and MOT_FWD (R16 pad 2) open

steps.what: APHASE via in U30 pad 6 at (50.00, 31.95) (filled + capped, like the other in-pad vias of this board)

steps.result: I2C_SDA, DOCK_N, ARM_CLK, APHASE x2 routed; MOT_FWD (R16 pad 2 at (42.3, 22.0), the pull-up sits in the rear pull-up row, 12 mm from the rest of the net) open

steps.what: GND tracks with an end in x 41.5-52.5 / y 21.0-33.5 (61 pieces; the pours carry GND) and the SUP_DONE B.Cu diagonal (43.78, 24.767)-(48.313, 29.301)

steps.cmd: OP_FIRST=MOT_FWD island_route_a.py -> MOT_FWD routed; SUP_DONE re-routed after removing two pieces in its way (OC_OK, MOT_FWD: island_fix_a.py, one round) and a 2-piece MOT_FWD leftover without via at (44.15, 25.21)

steps.what: B.Cu GND track (42.34, 21.171)-(41.083, 22.428) restored (U36.2 island, removed with the GND corridor rip); starved thermals C81.2, U3.2, R29.2, U30.3, U7B.4 -> full connection (zone_fix)

steps.cmd: python3 prune_dangling_a.py <board>: 13 exact duplicate segments + 4 dangling leftovers removed; one In1 DOCK_N track end and the SUP_OK via in U1 pad E4 stay (removing them opens a connection: KiCad flags them dangling although they carry it)
